header: Petrol (E20), diesel and LPG in the four metros: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata. The prices are those the oil marketing companies publish, as compiled daily on GoodReturns' pages (one page for petrol, one for diesel, one for LPG per city). I read the flat text of the page (src/lib/live/text.ts), each table by its heading. My self-check makes a changed page a loud error and never a wrong number: every city must be found in every table, every price must be a plausible one (petrol and diesel 60 to 200 rupees a litre, LPG within its range per cylinder size), and the 14.2 kg cylinder must cost more than the 5 kg one. A failure throws, and the card says the figures cannot be shown.

behaviours: petrol per litre as the page of 12 Nov 2026 had it: Delhi 102.12, Kolkata 113.51, Mumbai 111.21, Chennai 107.76
LPG of Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata 14.2 kg: 941.50, 957.50, 968
a change is read with its sign: +17.00 for the Kolkata 19 kg cylinder
the rupee sign written as an entity is decoded, tags become separators
a missing table is an error
a missing city is an error
an impossible price is an error: petrol at 10 rupees, LPG at 94 rupees
cylinders out of the order of their sizes are an error (the 5 kg dearer than the 14.2 kg)
a cylinder missing from the table is an error
the 4 cities are not confused with others in the list (Gurgaon and Noida follow Delhi in the page)
